period_note: SOUTH BANGLA AGRICULTURE AND COMMERCE BANK LIMITED (pre-2023 name). CONSOLIDATED basis (explicitly titled 'Consolidated Balance Sheet' / 'Consolidated Profit and Loss Account'; includes SBAC Bank Investment Limited, same as this bank's own 2021_Q2.json). No Solo alternative presented in this interim filing; the Consolidated/Solo difference remains negligible (non-controlling interest of Tk.394,770 against total equity of Tk.11,299.33m, i.e. 0.003%). FRESH SHARE ISSUE FOUND (distinct from this bank's earlier stock-dividend/bonus issues): paid-up capital rose from Tk.6,846,455,170 (30-Jun-2021) to Tk.7,846,455,170 here -- a flat increase of EXACTLY Tk.1,000,000,000 (100,000,000 new shares at Tk.10 par), not a percentage bonus; this does not match any bonus-share percentage in this bank's documented dividend-history table, and 'Paid-up Capital Issued' in the Statement of Changes in Equity confirms a cash/rights-style issue rather than a capitalisation of reserves. Total assets (93,995,510,508), total liabilities (82,696,181,646) and total equity (11,299,328,862 = Tk.11,298,934,092 attributable to the Bank's own shareholders + Tk.394,770 non-controlling interest) all reconcile exactly. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2021 (9 months); this filing also prints a discrete 'July to September' column, not used here (only the cumulative column is used, per this dataset's standing convention). Provision shortfall (Note 8.4, same Bangladesh Bank letter DBI-1/132/2021-1002) grew to Tk.420.39m (from Tk.387.07m at 30-Jun-2021 and Tk.371.44m at 31-Mar-2021). Classified loans (Note 8.5) were Tk.3,565,526,254 (NPL 5.66%). No capital-adequacy disclosure in this filing. BAS-33/FRESH-ISSUE-STYLE RESTATEMENT: this filing's own Note 2.09 prints BOTH an as-originally-reported Dec-2020 comparative NAV (13.59) and a 'Restated' Dec-2020 NAV (11.86, = Tk.9,306,658,399/784,645,517 CURRENT shares) -- diluted by this quarter's fresh share issue; similarly Note 2.11 shows H1/9M-2020 EPS both as originally reported (0.94 / 0.48 for 9M/Q3) and restated (0.82 / 0.42) using the current 784,645,517 shares. This dataset's own 2020_Q1/Q2/Q3.json files keep each quarter's first-published, contemporaneous EPS.
